title: Applecat Apples & More
description: Replaces the Apple & Golden Apple textures with the popular meme "Apple Cat"
body:
Replaces the Apple & Golden Apple textures with the popular meme "Apple Cat" versions of them. That is the only thing it does. 
If you are a fan of Applecat, then this pack is perfect for you! 
there will be more later too, such as paintings.
